properties.title: Contemporary 4-Bedroom Detached Duplex
properties.address: Off Admiralty Way, within a gated close near the Lekki Phase 1 roundabout.
properties.description: A newly completed four-bedroom detached duplex with a one-room boys’ quarters, set in a quiet gated close in Lekki Phase 1. The ground floor opens into a double-height living room, a separate family lounge and a fully fitted kitchen with a pantry and store. All bedrooms are ensuite, and the master suite has a walk-in closet and private balcony. The compound is interlocked with parking for four cars.

properties.title: Luxury 3-Bedroom Apartment
properties.address: Bourdillon Road axis, in a serviced residential block with 12 units.
properties.description: A refined three-bedroom apartment on the fourth floor of a serviced block off Bourdillon Road. The apartment has generous floor-to-ceiling windows, a guest toilet, a fitted kitchen with laundry area and a maid’s room. Residents share a pool, gym and a 24-hour power arrangement managed by the facility team.

properties.title: Modern 2-Bedroom Apartment
properties.address: Off Herbert Macaulay Way, a short walk from the Yaba tech corridor.
properties.description: A bright two-bedroom apartment in a compact, well-maintained building in Alagomeji, Yaba. Both rooms are ensuite with fitted wardrobes, and the open-plan kitchen and living area receives good natural light. Convenient for Yaba, Ebute Metta and the Third Mainland Bridge.

properties.title: 5-Bedroom Executive Duplex
properties.address: Quiet close within Enugu GRA, on a 1,200 sqm plot.
properties.description: An executive five-bedroom detached duplex on a generous plot in a quiet close within Enugu GRA. The home has formal and family living rooms, a study, a cinema room, a two-room boys’ quarters and a landscaped garden with space for a pool. Finishes include imported tiles, a hardwood staircase and a fitted kitchen with island.

properties.title: Residential Land, 600 sqm
properties.address: Eleko junction axis, Lekki–Epe Expressway.
properties.description: A dry 600 sqm residential plot within a developing estate at Eleko, Ibeju-Lekki. The estate has a perimeter fence, a gatehouse and graded internal roads. Suitable for a detached home or a pair of semi-detached units.

properties.address: Badore Road, Ajah.

properties.title: 2-Bedroom Flat
properties.address: Off Diya Street, Gbagada Phase 1.
properties.description: A well-kept two-bedroom flat in a block of four in Gbagada Phase 1, with a spacious living room, a guest toilet and a tiled compound.

properties.title: 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached Duplex

properties.title: 5-Bedroom Detached Duplex with BQ
properties.address: CMD Road end of Magodo GRA Phase 2, Shangisha.
properties.description: A spacious five-bedroom detached duplex in the secure Magodo GRA Phase 2 estate. The home includes a family lounge upstairs, a study, a two-room boys’ quarters and a large paved forecourt. The estate has controlled access and good internal roads.

properties.title: Serviced 3-Bedroom Apartment
properties.address: Oniru Estate, off Ligali Ayorinde Street.
properties.description: A fully serviced and furnished three-bedroom apartment in Oniru, Victoria Island, ideal for executives. Service charge covers power, water, cleaning of common areas, and security. Includes a rooftop lounge and gym.

properties.title: 4-Bedroom Terrace Duplex
properties.address: Ikate Elegushi, off the Lekki–Epe Expressway.
properties.description: A four-bedroom terrace duplex in a new development of eight units at Ikate. Each unit has a rooftop terrace, a fitted kitchen and a room for domestic staff. Delivered with solar backup and treated water.

properties.title: 3-Bedroom Bungalow
properties.address: Off Isaac John Street, Ikeja GRA.
properties.description: A charming three-bedroom bungalow on a mature plot in Ikeja GRA, with a garden, a covered car port and a one-room boys’ quarters. A good option for buyers who want single-level living close to the airport.

properties.title: 1-Bedroom Mini Flat
properties.address: Off Commercial Avenue, Sabo, Yaba.
properties.description: A neat one-bedroom mini flat in Sabo, Yaba, with a fitted kitchenette and prepaid meter. Close to the university and the Yaba bus terminal.

properties.title: 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached Duplex
properties.address: Off Olabode George Street, Gbagada Phase 2.
properties.description: A semi-detached four-bedroom duplex in Gbagada Phase 2 with a boys’ quarters, a spacious living and dining area and a quiet, well-lit street. Easy access to the Third Mainland Bridge and Ikorodu Road.

properties.title: 3-Bedroom Apartment
properties.address: Independence Layout, close to the Enugu–Abakaliki Road junction.
properties.description: A spacious three-bedroom apartment in a secure, managed building in Independence Layout. Includes fitted wardrobes, air conditioning in all rooms and dedicated parking.

properties.title: 4-Bedroom Detached Duplex
properties.address: Independence Layout, on a paved residential street.
properties.description: A modern four-bedroom detached duplex in Independence Layout, completed in 2026. Features a contemporary façade, a family lounge, a fitted kitchen and a boys’ quarters, with quick access to the city centre.

properties.title: Residential Plot, 1,000 sqm
properties.address: Achara Layout, off a tarred access road.
properties.description: A 1,000 sqm residential plot in an established part of Achara Layout. The area has tarred access roads and electricity connections nearby.

properties.title: Grade A Office Floor, 420 sqm
properties.address: Adeola Odeku Street, Victoria Island.
properties.description: An open-plan office floor in a Grade A building on Adeola Odeku Street, with raised floors, central air conditioning, a reception area and dedicated parking. Suitable for a professional services firm or regional headquarters.

properties.title: 4-Bedroom Detached Duplex
properties.address: New Haven, Enugu, within a fenced residential street.
properties.description: A family home in New Haven with a spacious compound, a two-room boys’ quarters and a large living room. Recently renovated with new roofing and a borehole.

properties.title: 3-Bedroom Apartment
properties.address: Uwani, Enugu, close to the main market road.
properties.description: A three-bedroom apartment in Uwani with a guest toilet, a fitted kitchen and a shared generator. Located close to schools and the city centre.

properties.title: 4-Bedroom Bungalow
properties.address: Trans-Ekulu, Enugu, on a fenced corner plot.
properties.description: A well-built four-bedroom bungalow in Trans-Ekulu on a fenced plot with fruit trees and a covered parking area.

properties.title: 3-Bedroom Flat
properties.address: Abakpa Nike, Enugu.
properties.description: A three-bedroom flat in a quiet compound in Abakpa Nike with spacious rooms, a large kitchen and steady water supply.

properties.description: A two-storey retail plaza with 14 shop units, a banking hall and on-site parking along the busy Ogui Road corridor. Currently 80% let.

properties.description: A three-bedroom semi-detached duplex in a serviced estate in Sangotedo. Delivered with a fitted kitchen, POP ceilings and an interlocked forecourt.

properties.title: 2-Bedroom Apartment

tickets.name: Grace Afolabi
tickets.subject: Moving-in date for my Yaba apartment

messages.body: Hello, once I make the rent payment, how soon can I move in? I would like to plan for 1 December.
Good morning Grace. Your lawyer, Nneka Eze, will confirm the move-in date with the landlord once both payments are received. I have flagged your preferred date on your case.
Good afternoon. I own a four-bedroom duplex in Nsukka. Do you accept listings outside Enugu city, and what information will your lawyers need from me?

tickets.name: Samuel Okoro
tickets.subject: Caller claiming to be from ELVICTORIA

messages.body: I received a call from someone who said he was an ELVICTORIA agent and asked me to pay a "booking fee" for the Ikate terrace into a personal account. Is this genuine?
Our company is relocating six staff to Lagos in January. Can your team help us find serviced apartments on the Island and manage the tenancies?
Thank you for contacting ELVICTORIA. A member of our team called you this afternoon to discuss your requirements. Please register an account so each enquiry can be assigned to a lawyer.
Photos taken on my phone were not uploading for a new listing.
Thanks Femi. Images above 8 MB are not accepted. Please reduce the photo size or use the “Medium” camera setting and try again.
